description: Order-of-magnitude estimate of bandwidth offloaded (and hosting dollars, if a $/GB is given) when bytes move from first-party hosting to UNPKG. Range-based with explicit assumptions and caveats; it cannot forecast latency or Core Web Vitals. Get unpkgBytesPerPageLoad from audit_dependencies' impact.convertNowEntryBytes plus any transitive files the caller chooses to include.

bandwidthCostPerGbUsd.description: Current hosting $/GB, if known. Omit to skip dollars.

browserCacheRate.description: Share of loads served from browser cache. Default 0.5.

unpkgBytesPerPageLoad.description: Raw bytes per page load moving to UNPKG.

name: estimate_migration_impact
title: Rough bandwidth/cost impact of a conversion
